file_reviews.assessment: Audited Paper 004 Sections 8 and 9 covering the six retained Lean 4 modules, the 86-theorem axiom census scope, and explicit non-formalization boundaries for the native host and receipt fields.
Audited Paper 004 claim ledger row P4-16 specifying pinned Lean build and 86-theorem axiom census alongside formal ceiling disclaimers.
Audited unpacked toolchain pin leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0 and verified clean out-of-tree compilation under Lean 4.35.0.
Audited Lake library target SymbolGame declaring the six root modules TotalUnimodularity, IdentityTypes, Topology50, SparseLanding, SnTower, and SparseLandingGeneral.
Audited deterministic census driver importing the six Lake roots and issuing 86 #print axioms commands matching render_census output byte-for-byte.
Audited 86-declaration axiom dependency report (47 axiom-free, 39 using subsets of propext, Quot.sound, and Classical.choice) recorded at leanprover/lean4:v4.34.0-rc1.
Audited five theorems covering directed incidence sign entries, signed column-sum bounds, and coboundary difference vanishing.
Audited three theorems covering constructive path symmetry involution, primitive difference equivalence, and quotient class equality.
Audited ten Set algebra theorems and fifty general topology benchmark theorems compiled without external Mathlib dependencies.
Audited ten integer theorems covering iabs properties, asymmetric 3-cycle weighted null-space inequality, unique cost-1 landing, and uniform-weight tie witness.
Audited five Boolean and carrier-distinction theorems covering irreflexive endpoint inequality, subsingleton exclusion, D2 rigidity, and S2 swap invariance.
Audited three list-coordinate directional derivative theorems (term_le, margin_le_dirDeriv, dirDeriv_pos) and verified their Classical.choice elaboration shift between Lean v4.34.0-rc1 and v4.35.0.
Audited parse_report, import_roots, render_census, check_census, and replay_census enforcement of header-count agreement, duplicate detection, and ordered declaration parity.

Audited Paper 005 Sections 4 and 5 covering offline scoring normalization, ASSERT/section-CUT exact input guards, dual-payload refusal, EDGE_MATCH declared-edge checks, and ZERO_OBSTRUCTION vs ZERO_DEFECT semantics.

Audited Paper 005 claim ledger rows G005-14 (offline scoring refusals and Edge-key normalization), G005-15 (ASSERT and section CUT input guards), and G005-16 (EDGE_MATCH scope and global obstruction).

Audited compute_phi1 duplicate-carrier and undeclared-edge guards plus Edge-key normalization, step_assert and step_cut exactness/carrier/dual-payload refusals, and step_verify EDGE_MATCH, ZERO_OBSTRUCTION, and ZERO_DEFECT branches.
Audited run_to_terminal integration driving L1SymbolGameGovernor, compute_phi1 on normalized tuple keys, and ZERO_OBSTRUCTION terminal verification.

Audited behavioral contract tests for offline scoring refusals, Edge-key normalization, non-exact ASSERT and section CUT refusals, dual-payload MoveViolation, and EDGE_MATCH / ZERO_OBSTRUCTION / ZERO_DEFECT discrimination.

claims.statement: The six package Lean modules build under the pinned toolchain, and the census lists the axioms of all 86 theorems.
dependencies: Clean out-of-tree lake build under leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0 (exit 0 across all six declared Lake root modules).
Bijection between the 86 theorem declarations across the six .lean files and the 86 #print axioms entries in Census.lean and axiom_report.txt.
Exact replay_lean_axiom_census.py --replay success under leanprover/lean4:v4.34.0-rc1 and whitelisted three-theorem Classical.choice elaboration shift in SparseLandingGeneral.lean under v4.35.0.
claims.limits: Complements PAPER004-CONDITIONAL-LEAN-SLICE; none of the 86 finite/topology theorems formalizes the native Rust host or protocol receipts, and axiom_report.txt records v4.34.0-rc1 where three SparseLandingGeneral theorems omit Classical.choice relative to v4.35.0.

claims.statement: Offline scoring refuses undeclared claim edges and duplicate carrier entries; supported Edge keys are normalized before scoring.
dependencies: Duplicate vertex and duplicate directed-edge checks in compute_phi1 raising ValueError.
Claim-key normalization mapping Edge instances to (u, v) tuples and rejecting malformed, undeclared, or colliding keys.
Exact rational spanning-forest enumeration scoring the normalized Cochain1 when CORE_FUNCTIONAL_GRAPH_BIN is unset.
claims.limits: Applies to the patched v0.1 companion compute_phi1; declared edges omitted from direct Cochain1 construction still default to zero outside step_cut.

claims.statement: ASSERT and section CUT refuse non-exact values; section CUT refuses unknown vertices and a CUT cannot silently choose one of two supplied payloads.
dependencies: Exact type check type(value) not in (int, Fraction) in step_assert and section step_cut refusing bool and float values with IncompleteProposal.
Vertex-membership set difference in section step_cut refusing undeclared vertices with CarrierViolation.
Dual-payload mutual exclusion in step_cut refusing simultaneous proposed_section and proposed_claims with MoveViolation while preserving edge_claims, section, and history.
claims.limits: Active edge_claims, section, and admitted history snapshots remain unchanged upon refusal, whereas _step_counter advances by one per invocation.

claims.statement: EDGE_MATCH requires a declared edge, and local equality does not discharge a global obstruction.
dependencies: Declared-edge lookup self.graph.edge_by_pair(*pair) and 2-element arity check on EDGE_MATCH obligations in step_verify.
Residual cycle obstruction invariance (with PAPER005-INSTANCE-REPLACEMENT) keeping ZERO_OBSTRUCTION false when local declared edges match.
Distinct obligation evaluators in step_verify separating ZERO_OBSTRUCTION (min_f D_c(f) == 0) from ZERO_DEFECT (D_c(s) == 0).
claims.limits: Covers governor obligation semantics in step_verify complementing PAPER005-INSTANCE-REPLACEMENT; does not establish whole-domain semantic validity or record VERIFY calls in governor.history.
